full_prompt_en: A square historical oil painting presents the upper body of a solemn blond young man against a dark, weathered architectural background. The wall behind him is nearly black on the left and warmer brown on the right, where a tall vertical stone or plaster panel carries worn, uneven marks. The background is layered with rough strokes and thin rubbed passages rather than a smooth studio gradient. The man's head occupies the upper center. Short pale blond hair is combed forward and across his forehead, with light catching its soft strands. He turns slightly toward the viewer's left while looking outward, his face firm and unsmiling. Warm light shapes the broad forehead, straight nose, lips, and one side of the cheek; the opposite eye and jaw move into a deeper, brownish shadow. A high black collar rises around his neck and meets a narrow pale shirt edge. His heavy dark coat fills the lower half and reaches both side edges, its shoulders broad but softened by the surrounding shade. In the center of the chest, an intricate gold and brown brocade-like surface catches small broken glints of light. A narrow red accent appears near the throat. At the viewer's right side of his chest, a small striped ribbon holds a bright, star-shaped decoration whose pale points stand out against the coat. The decorative metal and textile are rendered in concentrated dabs, contrasting with the large near-black masses of clothing. The figure sits forward of the wall through strong value separation around the illuminated hair and face, while parts of the coat disappear into the background at the left and bottom. Light arrives from the upper left and front, giving the face and ornament the clearest highlights and leaving the far side of the wall and coat subdued. The painted surface combines precise facial modeling with more broken, impasto-like marks in the background and ornate fabric. The overall composition is upright and tightly framed, balancing golden detail and pale skin against a deep, earthy field to create a dignified, introspective atmosphere.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形历史题材油画呈现一位神情肃穆的金发青年上半身，身后是深暗、风化的建筑表面。左侧墙面近乎漆黑，右侧转为更暖的棕色，一条高而竖直的石质或灰泥墙面带着磨损、不均匀的痕迹。背景由层层粗糙笔触和薄薄擦过的色面构成，并非平滑影棚渐层。男子的头位于画面上部中央。浅金色短发向前并横过额头梳理，柔软发丝接住光线。他略向观者左侧转身，目光朝外，脸部坚毅而没有笑意。暖光塑造宽阔额头、挺直鼻梁、嘴唇和一侧面颊；另一侧眼睛与下颌进入更深的褐色阴影。高高的黑领围住颈部，与一线浅色衬衣相接。厚重深色外套填满画面下半部，伸向两侧边缘，宽阔肩部在周围阴影中略显柔化。胸口中央，繁复的金褐色锦缎般表面接住细碎光点。喉咙附近露出一道狭窄红色重音。观者右侧胸前，一小段条纹绶带悬着明亮的星形勋饰，浅色尖角从外套上凸显。装饰金属和织物由集中的点状笔触描绘，与大块近黑衣物形成对照。受光的头发和脸与墙面的明度分离，使人物处于前方，而外套部分边缘在左侧和底部融入背景。光从左上方及前方到来，让面部与勋饰获得最清晰的高光，使远侧墙面及外套保持低调。绘画表面将细致的面部塑形与背景、华丽衣料中更破碎、近似厚涂的痕迹结合。整体构图竖向而紧密，以金色细节与浅色皮肤对照深沉的大地色域，营造庄重内省的气氛。
style_prompt_en: The oil-painted treatment sets carefully modeled, warm luminous passages against broad near-black and umber masses. Dark edges often dissolve into a textured ground, while selected light boundaries remain crisp enough to pull the central form forward. Pale gold, ivory, rust red, and muted bronze occupy small concentrated areas within a much larger field of charcoal brown and black-green. Fine flecks and short loaded strokes create metallic or brocade-like sparkle without smoothing away the paint. Background surfaces have rubbed, weathered vertical variation, giving the dark space tactile depth instead of a uniform gradient. Directional light from above and one side brings out rounded volume, then falls decisively into warm shadow. The composition keeps its weight near the middle and allows dim peripheral marks to remain subordinate. The overall effect is stately and introspective, with precise focal modeling held inside a rougher, earthy painted atmosphere.
style_prompt_zh: 油画表现把精心塑形的温暖受光区域置于大块近黑和深褐色面之中。深色边缘常融入有肌理的底面，而少数受光边界保持足够清晰，将中心形体推到前方。浅金、象牙白、锈红和低调古铜色集中在小片区域，周围则是面积大得多的炭褐与黑绿色。细小色点和短促厚实笔触营造金属或锦缎般的闪烁，同时保留颜料本身的痕迹。背景表面呈现擦磨、风化的竖向变化，让深色空间具有可触的深度，而非均匀渐层。来自上方及一侧的定向光显出圆润体积，随后果断地衰减为暖色阴影。构图把重量保持在中央，使昏暗的外围痕迹处于次要位置。整体效果庄严内省，精准的视觉焦点塑形被包裹在更粗粝、更具大地色气息的绘画氛围中。
theme_en: A solemn blond man in a dark coat with a decorated chest
theme_zh: 身着深色外套、胸前佩戴勋饰的肃穆金发男子
name: Jean-Joseph Benjamin-Constant
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
